settings.question: How long does a made-to-order shirt take?
settings.answer: Each shirt is cut and stitched after you order. Most pieces ship in 7–10 days. You'll get an update at every stage.

settings.question: Can I order to my own measurements?
settings.answer: Yes. On any shirt choose “Make it to my measurements” and enter bust, waist, shoulder, sleeve and length. See our size guide for how to measure.

settings.question: Can I return a made-to-order piece?
settings.answer: Because each shirt is made for you, we offer a free alteration instead of a return. [Client to confirm final policy.]

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: Sign in to your account, or open the link in your confirmation email. Visit Track order.

settings.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: UPI, cards, net banking and wallets via Razorpay.
